caption: Incident Report Activity
description: Incident Report Activity events report the lifecycle of a documented incident. Classification follows the dual-coding pattern established by the Emergency Incident Data Document: a required common type from the incident_type_id enum, alongside the reporting organization's own internal type. Optional crosswalk attributes carry the equivalent public safety and offense codes where the incident maps to them.
name: incident_report_activity

2.caption: Updated
2.description: An existing incident report was amended.

3.caption: Submitted
3.description: The report was submitted for review.

4.caption: Approved
4.description: The report was approved by a supervisor.

7.caption: Referred
7.description: The incident was referred to a public safety agency or to the client.

99.caption: Other
99.description: The event activity is not mapped. See the activity_name attribute, which contains a data source specific value.
